scope: Offline-only, matched strict-OOS test of causal support/resistance head outputs appended to the existing paired MC1 residual mapper. No live, canonical, execution, policy, or frozen model artifact changed.

causality.candidate_contract: The S/R merge is one-to-one on candidate_id and decision timestamp, preserves target-free candidate sequence exactly, and does not gate eligibility when an S/R snapshot is missing.
causality.sr_source: Only causal_sr_heads_oof_20260830_v3_entrypivotfix is accepted. Its held-month S/R heads are trained on interactions resolved before that held month. Oracle and noncausal paths are rejected.
causality.mapper: The existing monthly paired MC1 residual mapper target is policy_net_bps minus the contemporaneous mean of BCF/current MC1 expected bps. Each fold fits only labels resolved before its held month; the only arm difference is the appended causal S/R output block and availability indicator.
causality.labels: Immutable rich-policy labels are source-aligned. Unreadable label parts are excluded by whole symbol in every compared arm and are neither imputed nor substituted.
causality.execution: All runs are offline. The output manifest records zero exchange-writing calls and no live execution path was invoked.

commands: post-run target-free audit: no duplicate selected candidate IDs; no more than two selections per timestamp; no policy or label fields in selection files; no oracle source; candidate identity preserved
validation.results: Focused contract tests: 3 passed. Full portfolio-constrained OOS result: causal S/R w100 improves the matched control from +9.27 to +38.84 bps/trade over Jun-Aug 2026, including an untouched August improvement from -5.50 to +43.42 bps/trade. It remains a challenger pending composed E2+H4 validation.
